name: web-extension-template
description: This is a template for creating Chrome extensions using Vite and Manifest V3.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome vite build --config vite.config.js && mkdir -p output/package && web-ext build --source-dir='output/dist-chrome' --artifacts-dir='output/package' --filename=chrome-extension.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET=firefox vite build --config vite.config.js && mkdir -p output/package && web-ext build --source-dir='output/dist-firefox' --artifacts-dir='output/package' --filename=firefox-extension.xpi --overwrite-dest
